description: Ministry of Digital Infrastructure & Information Technology - Regulations of ''e - Registration of Persons Data Base''
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the Electronic Transactions Act, No. 19 of 2006. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification as it deals with regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements under existing legislation.
